text: ANDREY DECISION: Spec and Plan must be TWO DIFFERENT OBJECTS, not two views of one section set. Today: one Plan{sections} rendered as SPEC-node (prose view) + PLAN-node (structural view) — same sections, FE SectionNode variant. Target: a separate Spec entity with its OWN sections (prose), a Plan with its OWN task-bearing sections, connected by explicit typed edges (spec_section ↔ plan_section). Brainstorm §29 (data model/storage/migration, link model, coverage across two objects, optionality, CLI, canvas render generalizing §26 worlds).

SPEC-OBJECT synth (codex 21ea5411, 1/2). Spec = first-class SIBLING JSON .codeterm/specs/sp_<uuid>.json (single-writer+watched+externalized .md+INDEX.md). Spec{id,title,project_path,status,sections[SpecSection prose],links,canvas}. PlanSection becomes work-breakdown (no longer spec source); tasks keep Task.section_ids vs plan section ids. Link = SpecPlanLink{spec_id,spec_section_id,plan_id,plan_section_id,kind:satisfies|implements|decomposes|related} stored canonically in Plan.spec_links + mem-indexed by spec_id; Plan.primary_spec_id optional/UI-only; n:m both ways.

ANDREY SHARPENED §29 model: SPEC=WHAT we want (intent), PLAN=HOW we do it (approach), TASK=concrete granular work on PLAN sections (+granular desc). Spec links ONLY to plan sections, NEVER to tasks. MILESTONES→rename 'work points' (work done / status change / brief what-updated; NOT history); attach to spec+plan+tasks; GROUPABLE like tasks. Spec+Plan+Tasks+work-points = ONE 'complete work'; multiple complete-works exist and LINK to each other (= plan lineage). NO legacy/migration (test-covered, no users) — manually reshape the current dogfood. Naming = separate brainstorm (names tentative).

CLI MIS-TARGET ROOT CAUSE (Andrey): the installed CLI is GLOBAL (~/.codeterm/bin); a worker ran ./build.sh cli and its socket-discovery now resolves to a DIFFERENT instance (batchtest), so codeterm plan record from the orchestrator hit the wrong daemon (plan not found). Dogfood plan is SAFE on 7686 (direct curl works). FIX NEEDED: CLI must be per-instance OR strictly honor CODETERM_API_PORT/CODETERM_INSTANCE so rebuilding one dev CLI never redirects another. Workaround now: dogfood via curl to 7686.

NAMING brainstorm (2 reports). CODEX scheme: Work(bundle)/Spec(what)/Approach(how, rename Plan)/Task/Update(work-point)/Coverage(spec-approach)/Lineage(work-work). OPUS scheme A: Effort(bundle)/Spec(what)/Plan(how, KEEP)/Task/Stride(work-point)/Lineage(effort-effort --follows); opus alt B: Plan=whole bundle, Approach=how. DIVERGENCE for Andrey: bundle=Work|Effort|Plan; HOW=Approach(rename)|Plan(keep); work-point=Update|Stride|Step. Awaiting Andrey pick.

ANDREY PICKED naming scheme (opus A): EFFORT=bundle/complete-work; SPEC=WHAT (prose sections); PLAN=HOW (keep, sections); TASK=granular (groupable+subtasks); STRIDE=work-point (renamed from milestone — retrospective progress mark + status delta, NOT a log, groupable, on spec/plan/task); LINEAGE=Effort->follows->Effort link; spec<->plan = structural (both in one Effort). CLI nouns: effort spec plan task stride lineage. Minimal rename — only new words Effort + Stride; Spec/Plan/Task kept. group/phase reused for task-groups AND stride-groups.

§29 BE dispatched (codex, worktree codeterm-spec, feat/spec-object, isolated dev 7693): Spec entity + spec_links grid + two-hop coverage + spec/effort CLI + batch spec ops + tests. NO live dogfood reshape (deferred, coordinated with §26 canvas). NO milestone→stride rename (separate task). NO canvas FE (separate lane after §26).

implemented Spec entity/storage, plan-owned spec links, two-hop coverage, batch ops, REST/socket RPC, CLI/docs, effort lineage; checks: build.sh check, focused spec tests, 7693 smoke, pre-push cargo check/fmt/clippy passed; full build.sh test had one unrelated flaky multiplexer history failure that passed in isolation

§29 Spec BE integrated to feat/canvas (BE 64cf4e0a): first-class Spec storage + externalized bodies + INDEX.md, plan-owned spec_refs/spec_links/primary_spec_id, effort lineage, two-hop coverage w/ unplanned state, spec/effort REST+socket+CLI+batch ops, manifest/docs regenerated. cargo check clean. Dogfood NOT reshaped, Canvas NOT touched (deferred/coordinated). Remaining: canvas un-fork (SPEC node=entity) + manual reshape + milestone→stride rename.
